pages.text: Milo had a red kite that was almost as big as he was. One windy morning, the string slipped right out of his hands.
Up, up, up it went, over the hills and past the old windmill. Milo ran after it as fast as his legs could go.
At last the kite landed in a big green tree, where a family of owls was waiting. 'Stay for tea?' they hooted. And Milo did.
